SearchAdmission.bounds: One query; native/projection/owned_file/foreign_source/disabled_skill/unmapped_file/wrong_workspace/ai_search/empty responses; four epoch owners; at most one external change; two ticks.
SearchAdmission.assumptions: Weak fairness of local preflight, clock ticks and timeout. No network success or remote completeness assumption. A source epoch means newly accepted evidence, not instantaneous knowledge of external Notion changes.
SearchAdmission.scope: Discovery admission and current publication across positive, empty and failure outcomes. CLI owns source/grant/deadline fences; Broker owns session and metadata qualification. These source hashes establish only the local reviewed portion of a cross-repository contract.

implementation_bindings.name: fresh_source_and_connection
implementation_bindings.scope: REST resolves before authorization. Source scope and descriptor are reread after authorization and at publication. The MCP user/workspace is verified and the exact selected entry fetched before query. An OAuth refresh cannot switch connection or grant epoch for the old request.

implementation_bindings.name: physical_admission
implementation_bindings.scope: Exact Skills/Files data-source membership, one complete File owner, unique stable claims including disabled rows, retained negative claim, ready owner and enabled ready Source revision. Main-source eligibility applies even to a native supporting match. Final owner/File/Source rereads guard late accepted changes.

implementation_bindings.name: bounded_remote_semantics
implementation_bindings.scope: Only observed workspace_search results, bounded physical Notion IDs and safe URLs, strict protocol/schema and request/byte/deadline budgets. No generic MCP dispatch, body/resource acquisition, fabricated continuation cursor, exact-byte claim or exhaustive absence conclusion.

implementation_bindings.name: public_sdk_boundary_regression
implementation_bindings.scope: Real loopback REST and MCP services, independent private credential store, preflight dispatch ordering, no explicit-token fallback, wrong workspace/entry suppression, positive/empty responses, revoked/replaced grants during query/401 refresh, cancellation and deadline propagation. No product function is mocked.

implementation_bindings.name: sdk3_physical_library_scope

REST physical Library validation still precedes authorization, reruns after authorization and before publication, while grant/connection/current-owner checks and non-exhaustive search semantics remain. New independent HTTP fixtures serve real root/DB/DS placement; queue/latch cancellation and deadline tests wait on the intended query rather than counting root schema traffic as Skill/File body reads.

unmodeled_bindings.scope: Enabled feature gate, active graph/pin preservation, session/branch transitions and whole-result publication tickets are Broker obligations. The standalone model includes them as abstract input facts; this CLI suite does not establish those host implementations.

Notion indexing/tokenization, Unicode matching, real title/body/nested/supporting results, projection-versus-Git divergence, real OAuth/token use, parser bytes and network lifecycle need concrete/installed/live evidence. Arbitrary concurrency, global permission atomicity and unknown external revocations are not proved by this finite model.
